Sejuani|jgl.identity: Magic damage tank who specializes in engage and chain CC. Arctic Assault (Q) charges and knocks up, Winter's Wrath (W) strikes twice while slowing, and Permafrost (E) stuns a frozen target (once it has built up Frost stacks, especially from your melee allies' attacks). Glacial Prison (R) stuns a champion from range and creates a storm that slows. Her passive gives her resistances out of combat.
Sejuani|jgl.playstyle: Tank jungler built for ganks and teamfights, most effective with melee allies (they add Frost stacks). Sejuani is very reliable in team fights thanks to her chain CC.
Sejuani|jgl.early_game: Clear safely with W (maxed) and E. Gank when your laner can follow up: Q to knock up, W to slow and stack Frost, E to stun. Avoid duels against junglers who kite you (Lillia).
Sejuani|jgl.level_2: Winter's Wrath (W). Two hits that slow and stack Frost: your clear speeds up. W is maxed first.
Sejuani|jgl.level_3: Arctic Assault (Q). First gank: Q (knock-up) → W → E once the target is frozen.
Sejuani|jgl.level_6: Glacial Prison: stuns the first champion hit, then the storm slows the area around it. Cast it from range to engage a teamfight or catch a carry who steps up.
power_spikes: Level 6: long-range engage with your ultimate.
First completed item: a solid tank.
Mid game: teamfights with melee allies.
Sejuani|jgl.jungle_plan: Safe clear and ganks with Q. Sejuani is stronger with melee laners: gank those lanes first to make the most of Frost. Control Scuttles, Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons. Avoid duels against ranged junglers or junglers who kite you.
Sejuani|jgl.trading: Ganking: Q → W → E. Teamfighting: R on the enemy carry or the closest target, then Q and W to stack Frost, E to stun. Give up on it against champions who kite you (Lillia).
threats: Lillia and champions who kite you.
Teams with no melee allies to stack Frost.
mistakes: Casting E on a target that isn't frozen.
Engaging with your ultimate without follow-up.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: He'll invade you: don't duel, gank.
matchup_notes.Viego: Stun him with R when he dives.
matchup_notes.Graves: He beats you in duels: gank where he isn't.
matchup_notes.Lillia: She kites you and puts you to sleep: play with your team.
matchup_notes.Trundle: His Subjugate steals your resistances: avoid long fights against him.

Sejuani|jgl.late_game: Teamfight engage: R on the carry or the closest target, then Q, W and E.
Sejuani|jgl.ahead: Gank, take objectives and force fights.
Sejuani|jgl.behind: Tank for your team and play for a decisive engage.
Sejuani|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to engage teamfights with your ultimate and chain CC with your melee allies.
Sejuani|jgl.final_tip: Cast Permafrost when the target is frozen: that stun decides the fight.
